prices.name: Standard listing
prices.what: 30 days in the list and in search, its own page readable by Google’s job box, a link straight to your application page. Checked before it goes live.

prices.name: Standard boost
prices.what: 30 days: a highlighted row with a “Featured” mark, above the free jobs in its lists (category, role, place, search), and views and clicks on Apply for the job in your account. For a job posted here or one we already list from your careers page.

prices.name: Premium boost
prices.what: 30 days: everything in the Standard boost, plus a turn in the top 3 slots of its lists, an “Urgently hiring” badge for the first 14 days, your logo and a cover image on the job page, one invitation email to up to 50 job seekers who asked for invitations and match the job, and views and clicks day by day. A listed job needs its company page claimed first.

prices.name: Hiring Pass
prices.what: 30 days for one company: unlimited Standard boosts for its jobs (each runs its own 30 days), 3 Premium boosts, the company spotlight and stats. The company must be yours: you posted a job under its name or claimed its page.

prices.name: Company spotlight
prices.what: 30 days: your company in “Featured employers” on the home page and at the top of the companies list, and a badge on your company page.

prices.name: Category or skill sponsor
prices.what: 30 days: your company named at the top of one category or skill page, for example “Engineering jobs · supported by you”.

prices.name: Bump to top
prices.what: Once: the job moves to the top of its date-sorted lists as if it were new. Its real posting date stays on it.

prices.name: Extend a boost by 30 days
prices.what: 30 more days of the Standard boost for a job whose boost is running or ended in the last 14 days. Once per boost.

prices.name: Urgently hiring badge
prices.what: An “Urgently hiring” badge for 14 days, on a job posted here or a listed job of a company whose page you claimed.

prices.name: 100 credits
prices.what: Prepaid credits: 1 credit = $1, for every product here, for employers and job seekers. They last 12 months from the top-up; a purchase paid with credits switches on at once.

prices.name: 250 credits
prices.what: Prepaid credits: 1 credit = $1, for every product here, for employers and job seekers. They last 12 months from the top-up; a purchase paid with credits switches on at once.

prices.name: 550 credits
prices.what: Prepaid credits with a 10% bonus (550 for $500): 1 credit = $1, for every product here, for employers and job seekers. They last 12 months from the top-up; a purchase paid with credits switches on at once.

prices.name: 1,200 credits
prices.what: Prepaid credits with a 20% bonus (1,200 for $1,000): 1 credit = $1, for every product here, for employers and job seekers. They last 12 months from the top-up; a purchase paid with credits switches on at once.

prices.name: Resume search: 50 contact requests
prices.what: Search the resumes people chose to make findable. Names and contacts stay hidden until the person accepts; a request is used up only when they do (declined, or no answer in 14 days: it comes back).

passes.name: One tailored resume
passes.what: Your resume reworded for one posting, with the keywords it misses, and a cover letter for that posting. One use, within 30 days.

passes.name: One mock interview
passes.what: Questions taken from one posting, and feedback on up to 8 typed answers. One use, within 30 days.
